versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-paraphraser: AI-powered tool for transforming AI-generated content into natural, human-like writing.
- Supports three paraphrasing modes: Light, Medium, and Aggressive, tailored to user needs and AI detection risks.
- Focuses on eliminating statistical patterns targeted by AI detectors while preserving original meaning.
- Delivers unique, non-duplicative rewrites with adjustable structural and stylistic changes.
- Built-in workflow for analyzing source text, executing paraphrasing, and ensuring quality against AI-associated traits.
